data.overview: On the eve of a French uprising, two girls raised as sisters leave their village for Paris, hoping to find a cure for one girl's blindness after plague takes their parents. Separated on the road by a predatory nobleman, each must survive a city on the brink.
data.title: Sisters of the Revolution
